name: Molten Gold Density
author: shander
description: Gold melting in the Smelter always turns into liquid gold - never randomly does nothing - but liquid gold now packs 2 solid pixels into every 1 liquid pixel, deterministically. Each liquid pixel is worth double, so total sell value never changes: only the physical footprint shrinks. 1000 pixels of solid gold in, 500 pixels of liquid gold out, still worth 1000.
